semantic_rules.identity: Case-sensitive authored ID, global database within a diagram. First occurrence owns placement/span/directions; repeat declarations update only non-na type and non-id caption. Occurrence facts remain separate from merged identities.
semantic_rules.implicit_nodes: Every edge endpoint is an ordinary declaration; a missing endpoint first appears in its statement parent. Existing endpoints remain in first parent without duplicate placement.

source_palette_authority.slot_rule: With a nonempty border palette, emitted and stamped slots equal palette.length, irrespective of THEME_COLOR_LIMIT. Source colorIndex modulo palette.length selects color-N. The default two shipped border palettes each have 12 slots.
